name: Beas de Granada (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white triangle issuing from the hoist bearing a pomegranate.
history: Beas de Granada adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 April 2010; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, red above and green below, with a white triangle at the hoist bearing a pomegranate proper.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
